bootBody: GRUB boots this kernel from now on, until another is chosen or the newest again. It runs after a restart.
bootNewestBody: GRUB boots the newest installed kernel again, as it does without being told.
bootOnceBody: GRUB boots this kernel at the next restart only; the one after boots the default again.
installBody: The package and what it needs are installed from the machine's archive. GRUB offers the new kernel; it runs after a restart.
notOffered: The archive does not offer that package.
progressHint: You can close this window; the agent carries on.
removeBody: Its image and modules are purged. Nothing else is removed: if anything else would go with them, the removal stops.
removeBooted: GRUB boots this kernel: boot another one first.
removeLast: The last kernel cannot be removed.
removeNeeded: A series this machine follows needs this kernel.
removeRunning: The running kernel cannot be removed.
restartRequired: The machine asks for a restart.
title: Kernels
unsupported: Kernels are managed here on Debian and Ubuntu with GRUB.
versionsNote: Versions of the running kernel's flavour. A series installs the newest of its kind and keeps it updated; a version stays as it is.
